articles.title: Tether leads $1.4 billion funding round in German robotics company Neura
articles.snippet: The investment is part of the stablecoin giant’s expansion into industries outside of crypto.

articles.title: Citi opens new route into private markets with tokenized share offering
articles.snippet: The bank said it is using blockchain technology to connect investors with private company equity through digital depositary receipts.

articles.title: Corporate bitcoin buying has collapsed from $500 million per day to almost negligible
articles.snippet: ETF outflows have dominated the narrative but corporate bitcoin treasuries have gone quiet too, compounding the demand-side weakness.

articles.title: Coinbase-backed Stand With Crypto calls on members to campaign against banks blocking digital asset transactions
articles.snippet: Stand With Crypto UK is telling its members to file formal complaints with high-street banks over sector-wide transfer bans.

articles.title: Bitso brings peso-backed MXNB stablecoin to XRP Ledger via Ripple partnership
articles.snippet: The companies are pairing MXNB and RLUSD on the XRP Ledger to support institutional payments between the United States and Mexico as stablecoin adoption grows across Latin America.
